methodology: RAG lexical retrieval only; production 1200-char chunks/150 overlap, OR + BM25, top40 chunks, session-dedup top5. HanLP runs actual RagIndex.keyword(). Trigram >=3 terms use native FTS5 phrase BM25; shorter terms scan substrings with additive FTS5-formula BM25 (validated on a native phrase). Native-query baseline uses whitespace; shared-query control uses production HanLP terms incl single-Han filtering. Same scope, source, parent expansion and evidence budget. Five alternating warm repetitions after all three query paths prewarm. No embeddings or answer generation. All real data remain in ignored output; public summaries omit query/source text. No tuning on test results.
